text: Current-carrying capacity per IEC 60364-5-52 and IEC 60287 for the actual installation: air temperature 40 degC (DP-CASE-0008) or 45 degC in areas outside HVAC (DP-CASE-0009 survival range), soil temperature 25 degC at 1.0 m depth with a thermal resistivity of 1.5 K m/W, grouping and proximity factors of the actual tray fill. Cables in conduit or duct banks shall be derated for the worst duct.
